# archestra_app (Resource)

An Archestra App with its HTML, settings, sharing and upstream tools. Content versions are immutable revisions of this App. Omit HTML to preserve the existing content or use the platform starter on creation. Updates use content-version preconditions. Locked Apps must be explicitly unlocked before content changes or destruction. Creating an App does not open a conversation. Requires API 1.4.0-rc.50 or later.

## Example Usage

```terraform
resource "archestra_app" "runbook" {
  name                = "Runbook"
  html                = file("${path.module}/app.html")
  browser_permissions = []
  enabled             = true
  locked              = false
  open_in_fullscreen  = false
  labels              = [{ key = "purpose", value = "operations" }]

  # Tool assignments, when needed, belong on the App:
  # tools = [{ tool_id = data.archestra_tool.lookup.id,
  #            credential_resolution_mode = "dynamic" }]
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `name` (String)

### Optional

- `browser_permissions` (Set of String) Versioned browser permissions: camera, microphone, geolocation and clipboard_write. Omit to preserve; [] clears. A permission-only edit creates a content revision using the current HTML.
- `description` (String)
- `enabled` (Boolean) Whether the App is live. Omission preserves the observed value and creation honors organization defaults. Explicitly enable before editing disabled content.
- `environment_id` (String) Deployment environment UUID. Omission or removal explicitly selects the organization default environment.
- `html` (String, Sensitive) Complete UTF-8 HTML document, at most 512 KiB. Omit to preserve content. Stored in sensitive Terraform state; use file() to load a local document.
- `icon` (String)
- `labels` (Attributes Set) Key/value labels; omission preserves them and [] clears them. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--labels))
- `locked` (Boolean) Whether content edits and deletion are locked. Omission preserves the observed value. Explicitly unlock before content edits or destruction.
- `open_in_fullscreen` (Boolean) Default initial display mode; omission preserves the observed setting.
- `permissions` (Attributes Set) Additional direct sharing grants on this object. Applied atomically on creation and reconciled in place thereafter. Omit to preserve current grants; set [] to clear additional grants. The owner's existing grant is preserved automatically; inherited access and ownership remain managed by Archestra. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--permissions))
- `slug` (String) URL segment, generated from the name when omitted. Changing it breaks links that use the old slug; the UUID remains stable.
- `tools` (Attributes Set) Complete upstream tool assignments, including server pins and credential modes. Omit to preserve assignments; [] clears them. Each tool UUID may appear once. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--tools))

### Read-Only

- `author_id` (String)
- `author_name` (String)
- `backing_server_id` (String) Platform-managed backing MCP server. The App owns its lifecycle.
- `content_version` (Number) Observed immutable content revision; used as an optimistic concurrency precondition.
- `created_at` (String)
- `created_by_service_account_id` (String)
- `id` (String) The ID of this resource.
- `organization_id` (String)
- `updated_at` (String)
- `viewer_role` (String)

Optional:

- `mcp_server_id` (String) Backing MCP server UUID; omit to leave the assignment unpinned.

## Import

Import is supported using the following syntax:

The [`terraform import` command](https://developer.hashicorp.com/terraform/cli/commands/import) can be used, for example:

```shell
# Import the stable App UUID. HTML is read into sensitive Terraform state.
terraform import archestra_app.runbook 11111111-1111-4111-8111-111111111111
```
